Every tutorial is **hybrid**: roughly 40 minutes of pen-and-paper worksheet (the fluency you need in quizzes and exams) followed by 40 minutes of Jupyter notebook (the same idea, computationally). Bring a laptop. Tutorials are formative — effort, not marks.

## Assignments

Three take-home assignments grow out of the tutorials:

| # | Out after | Built from | One line |
|---|:---:|-----------|----------|
| A1 | L11 | T5 | Extend micrograd; verify against PyTorch; differentiate something fun |
| A2 | L21 | T10–T11 | Model and solve three real problems with CVXPY; certify optimality via KKT |
| A3 | L24 | T12–T13 | Build a Huffman compressor and an n-gram language model; compare bits/char against entropy and cross-entropy |
